== Original and remastered English issuer text ==
The remaster omits the explicit restriction to battle here. The period One Rule still limits the singular Interrupt substitution in a named battle to once per copy. The pilot bonus, Jedi modifiers and attrition immunity remain. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16603#page=1 Players Committee original sheet, p. 1, slip 12].
